Wave on Wave

4 Bedrooms 3 Full Bathrooms 1 Half Bathrooms 14 Sleeps Seagrove Beach
  • Description
  • Amenities
  • Reviews
  • Calendar
  • Location

Home Highlights:
- Private heated resort style pool (Pool can be heated for an additional $40 per day between Oct 1 - May 1)
- Gulf views
- Game room
- 6 adult bikes
- Six Seater Golf Cart

Wave on Wave is an extraordinary beachfront sanctuary nestled along Scenic 30A in the Seagrove Beach community. This three-story haven boasts 4 bedrooms, 3.5 bathrooms, and can comfortably accommodate up to 14 guests, making it the ideal setting for a family retreat or group getaway. Just a short 1-minute stroll from the nearest beach access, this residence offers a private pool, Gulf views, and various balconies to enhance your coastal experience.

As you step into this spacious beach oasis, the first floor welcomes you with a charming sitting area featuring two matching armchairs and a round table for four. Additionally, a cozy living room awaits with a queen sleeper sofa. Direct access to the private pool and patio with loungers invites guests to enjoy outdoor gatherings. Two bedrooms grace this floor – a guest bedroom and a bunk room with two twin-over-twin bunk beds. The laundry room, equipped with a full-size washer and dryer, adds convenience to your stay.

Ascending to the second floor, you’ll discover the heart of the home. An open living and kitchen area creates the perfect space for family gatherings. The living area is adorned with a large sofa, three chairs, and expansive windows that flood the space with natural light. Step outside onto the balcony to relish Gulf views. The gourmet kitchen boasts a French door refrigerator, stylish glass door cabinets, and a kitchen island with seating for five. A spacious dining room with seating for eight and a private guest bedroom with an en-suite bathroom complete this floor.

The third floor is designed for entertainment, featuring an A-framed game room with a pool table, TV, arcade game, and a media room with a comfortable sectional couch, wet bar, wine cooler, and ice machine. An additional guest bedroom and a queen sleeper sofa cater to last minute guests, ensuring a delightful experience for all.

Wave on Wave is not just a residence; it’s a gateway to the vibrant resort town of Seaside, located just 2 blocks away. Explore the local area on the six adult bikes provided with this home and indulge in the diverse array of shops and eateries offering delightful cuisine, tapas, and wine. Enhance your stay with the option of pool heating available from October 1 to May 1 for an additional $40 per day.

Home Layout
First Floor
- Sitting Area
- Queen Bedroom w/ Shared Bathroom with Shower Only
- Bunk Room w/ Two Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds w/ Shared Bathroom with Shower Only
- Family room w/ Queen Sleeper Sofa
- Laundry room

Second Floor
- Open Concept Living Room, Dining Room, and Kitchen
- Master King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate

Third Floor
- Game room
- King Bedroom w/ Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo
- Queen Sleeper Sofa
